scope: Maintainer review of two native tool availability trials; not independent certification
findings: Both runs failed wall-time budget; no final plan to grade for facts, time allocation or persona.

Image group actually offers six tools and requests image reading twice. Subsequent requests contain1 then4 image parts. Sum15 is repeated payload exposure including a failed attempt, not15 distinct pages or15 proven upstream images.
Text group offers five tools with0 image parts. Effective runtime flags match the requested flags after the probe correction.
Provider-response counts exclude attempts without usage; time-budget failures remain failures, not successful candidates.
Different tool catalogs, no repeated cells, no controlled cold/warm cache, and no completed outputs prevent causal quality or latency claims.
